answer: Each agent compiles the verifier LaTeX source with TeX Live 2024 within 30 minutes and publishes the PDF hash and 12-page count, mirroring verifier build. The verifier recompiles it and compares PDF hash and page count, checking sable cover and canyon diagram match. One honest agent runs 1 compile on 4 cores for a 150 POA bond; 10 fakes must run 10 compiles on 40 cores, so cost rises 10X. A mismatched PDF hash, wrong TeX version, wrong page count, or timeout slashes the 150 POA bond and freezes repeat offenders.
